note: Kiro as the orchestrator. It runs no Lane in-process, so every Lane is relayed. kiro.dev documents no variable Kiro sets in the shells it starts, so it is never detected: pass --orchestrator kiro or set DELEGATE_ORCHESTRATOR=kiro, and the default path relays every Lane anyway.
